scope: Independent code audit plus fresh separate-process direct-model replay of six selected articles, twelve generations; artifact comparison across all73pairs.
findings: No prior summaries or GPT/Gemini references enter the inspected generation path.
The independent replay used only current rawRS title/body and saved prompts, with a fresh local model load.
All 12 fresh output texts and selected token sequences reproduce the saved runs, including 4 identical and 2 changed cases.
Source copying from publisher decks/keypoint bullets is common;49 of 55 matching summaries are contiguous source text after whitespace normalization.
Deterministic beam decoding can select the same passage under different instruction prompts; it does not force a change in wording.
Repeated prompt exploration on these 73 articles makes them a development/comparison set; do not claim unseen-test generalization from it.
limits: Fresh inference was replayed for 6 articles, not all 73. All 73 saved pairs and generation code were audited.
This audit does not establish the contents of the pretrained model training corpus.
EOS completion and source copying do not establish successful beginner-friendly instruction following.
source_audit: read-only; original sources and saved generation outputs unchanged
